detail.longDescription: Hi HN, sharing a weekend hack: Botscent, a library to detect agents on your site * Detects Instinct, Muse, Dot, Grok Bot and many others * Works with ~all TypeScript and Python setups * Tiny (5KB), 0 deps, starts in 5ms Try it in your project to hide ads, change prices, log agents, simplify pages or just block agents entirely.
